description: Free courses, wargames and hands-on platforms. Start here.

resources.name: Awesome Cyber Security University
resources.description: A self-study curriculum of free resources, ordered from introduction to purple teaming.

resources.name: Awesome Cyber Skills
resources.description: Legal places to practice hacking skills: challenge sites, vulnerable apps and wargames.

resources.name: CryptoHack
resources.description: Free platform for learning modern cryptography by breaking flawed implementations of RSA, AES, elliptic curves and more.

resources.name: CTF Wiki
resources.description: Community knowledge base covering CTF categories: web, crypto, reverse engineering, pwn and misc.

resources.name: CTFtime
resources.description: Calendar of upcoming capture-the-flag events, team rankings and an archive of challenge writeups.

resources.name: Exploit Education
resources.description: Downloadable VMs for learning exploitation: Nebula (Linux privilege escalation), Phoenix (memory corruption) and Fusion (advanced).

resources.name: Hack The Box
resources.description: Hacking labs and machines. The free plan includes Starting Point tiers 0-2 and retired machines in Guided Mode.
resources.note: Free plan with limits; paid plans unlock more.

resources.name: Hacker101
resources.description: HackerOne's free web security class with videos and CTF-style exercises for aspiring bug bounty hunters.

resources.name: OverTheWire
resources.description: Classic wargames played over SSH. Start with Bandit for Linux basics, then move on to web (Natas) and binary games.

resources.name: picoCTF (CyLab Security Academy)
resources.description: Carnegie Mellon University's free learning platform, home of the picoCTF beginner competition.

resources.name: pwn.college
resources.description: Arizona State University's free, hands-on 'dojo' that teaches core security skills from the terminal up to binary exploitation.

resources.name: TryHackMe
resources.description: Guided rooms and learning paths in the browser. The free plan includes free rooms and a 1-hour daily AttackBox.
resources.note: Free plan with limits; paid plans unlock all paths.

resources.name: Web Security Academy
resources.description: Free interactive web security training from PortSwigger with hands-on labs for SQL injection, XSS, SSRF, access control and more.
